Find your dream role

Find your place and make a real impact, right here at Mobileye

  1. Engineering the AV future

    At Mobileye, we develop cutting-edge chips that drive the future of autonomous mobility. Our flagship EyeQ™ SoC delivers scalable, automotive-grade performance for both driver-assist and autonomous-driving solutions. Alongside EyeQ™, our advanced imaging radar chip enhances perception with high-resolution object detection - enabling smarter, safer driving in any environment.

    See hardware roles

  2. Driving innovation into everything we do

    From OS and drivers to compilers and high-level algorithms, Mobileye’s software team does it all. There is no line of code or challenge too small when we work to seamlessly integrate MLOps, DevOps, and any other creative tools we have – paving the way to an autonomous future.

    See software roles

  3. We give vehicles the ability to keep you safe

    With more than 250 million EyeQ™ chips installed in vehicles worldwide, Mobileye’s algo team is rewriting the roadmap of driving. By developing state-of-the-art algorithms, with both classic and advanced ML techniques, Mobileye is working “hands-on” with the technology that will enable drivers to take their “hands-off” the steering wheel.

    See algo roles

  4. Building intelligence for humanoids

    The Mentee by Mobileye team brings together simulation, advanced AI, and robotics hardware to build practical, scalable humanoids, designed to perceive, reason, and act in the physical world. Together, we’re developing intelligent machines designed to work safely alongside people and support everyday tasks in real-world environments.

    See robotics roles

  5. The bridge between the lab and the boardroom

    Our project and product managers play a pivotal role in shaping the future of autonomous driving technology. As the bridge between Mobileye and world-class automakers, they master our cutting-edge technology, lead cross-functional teams, manage customer relationships, ensuring the successful execution of complex projects.

    Product & project management roles

  6. Data-driven results

    Mobileye’s Data Force enables and streamlines product development to meet our most challenging goals. It transforms vast amounts of data into the artifacts needed to drive our algorithm development cycles. Data is at the heart of everything we do, continuously evolving and fueling our vision of autonomous vehicles.

    See data roles

What it means to be at Mobileye

“Mobileye has powerful collective drive to succeed. As a software engineer, I work simultaneously with various components, ensure seamless functionality, and deliver the most accurate results.”

Akiva Stern

Software Engineer

“We work with the leading automotive brands from around the world, as we adhere to the highest industry standards. Since I joined the company, my skills have only grown.”

Amit Geler

Director of AV TPM

“Many Hi-Tech companies are creating world-changing technology, making our lives easier, smarter, and more enjoyable. Still, almost none of them will make all of those while saving millions of lives worldwide!”

Lead Machine Learning Researcher

“Mobileye’s culture fosters creativity and innovation. At Mobileye, I develop advanced algorithms to produce real-time, high-quality 3D pedestrian modeling based on various sources. This work is crucial for enhancing safety and improving the overall driving experience by preventing unnecessary braking and ensuring smooth navigation.”

Ofir Orenstein

Algorithms Engineer

“At Mobileye, we create innovation daily in various ways you might not realize. For example, I work on cyber hardware and firewalls to protect Mobileye from cyber-attack and malware.”

Avi Green

HW Engineer & Security Architecture

“As a pipeline data engineer my biggest challenge is to program an effective, stable, and dynamic system that like the data, changes and evolves constantly.”

Snir Vaknin

AV Pipeline Data Engineering Team Lead
